card.writes: It promotes number-like pieces such as "-half", "-third" and "st", and suppresses Chinese words starting with "一", so it steers away from a Chinese "one" word.
card.plain: It marks the English word "one" when it stands for a person or thing, as in "one another" or "one of the".
